tasks.title: Add shared argv-to-arguments parser and usage generator

details.goal: One module in the shared kernel turns argv into the argument record a tool handler accepts, and prints a usage block generated from the tool's manifest literal, so the future `cgraph <tool>` command validates exactly what MCP validates.
steps: Create app/src/shared/cli/args.ts with the type declarations, GLOBAL_VALUE_FLAGS and the four validator functions moved from app/src/index.ts unchanged.
Add CliUsageError carrying `usage`, and splitGlobals with the documented removal and error rules.
Add parseCliArgs with the positional, flag, integer, boolean and array rules from the contract.
Add usageOf generating the header line, one line per declared field and the global-flags line.

Create app/tests/cli-args.test.ts: import the seven manifests directly, assert parseCliArgs binds the required positional (query/target) when given splitGlobals(argv).rest, and that defaults and unknown keys behave exactly as parseArgs does.

Add the failure and globals cases: unknown flag, missing flag value, non-integer integer, second positional, positional for a tool with no required field, bad enum, and splitGlobals removing --json/--help/-h/--repo-root/--data-dir in both forms; assert usageOf names every field of every manifest.
details.verify: cd app && $HOME/.bun/bin/bun test tests/cli-args.test.ts && $HOME/.bun/bin/bun run typecheck

progress.detail: Created app/src/shared/cli/args.ts (9 exports exactly: InputField, InputLiteral, ToolArgs, GLOBAL_VALUE_FLAGS, CliUsageError, splitGlobals, parseArgs, parseCliArgs, usageOf; parseArgs/matchesType/matchesItem/expectationOf moved verbatim from src/index.ts:283-357, AppError kept for both refusals; only #shared/errors imported, no node builtins needed, no console.log) and app/tests/cli-args.test.ts (24 tests, imports all seven manifests relatively). Contract notes: usageOf header is `cgraph <tool> [<name>] [options]` per the literal contract string; splitGlobals errors carry a module-private global usage line; `--name=` with an empty value is refused as "needs a value" (Number("") === 0 would otherwise slip through); a `--query` flag already set makes a later positional an "unexpected positional argument". Verify from app/: `$HOME/.bun/bin/bun test tests/cli-args.test.ts` -> 24 pass, 0 fail, 119 expect() calls; `$HOME/.bun/bin/bun run typecheck` -> exit 0, no output. Also ran `bun test tests/boundary.test.ts` -> 11 pass, 0 fail (shared-isolation intact) and `bunx biome check src/shared/cli/args.ts tests/cli-args.test.ts` -> clean after formatting those two files only. app/src/index.ts untouched.

Orchestrator verification: `bun test tests/cli-args.test.ts` 24 pass / 0 fail; `bun run typecheck` exit 0; `bun run lint` exit 0 (91 files); `bun test tests/boundary.test.ts` 11 pass (shared layer still isolated — args.ts imports only #shared/errors). Diff scope: only new app/src/shared/cli/args.ts and app/tests/cli-args.test.ts; app/src/index.ts untouched (git diff empty). Exports match the contract exactly; helpers nameOf/inlineValueOf/GLOBAL_USAGE stay module-private.

tasks.title: Add shared envelope renderer, status lines and exit-code mapping

details.goal: The CLI writes an envelope to stdout and derives its process exit code in one place, and `cgraph status` keeps printing exactly the four human lines it prints today.
steps: Create app/src/shared/cli/render.ts with the three functions and the two constants.
Implement statusLines by copying runStatus's formatting and replacing payload field access with guarded structural narrowing over `unknown`, keeping the unknown/unrecorded fallbacks.
Create app/tests/cli-render.test.ts building envelopes with the existing helpers from #shared/envelope (ok/fail/bootstrapping/ambiguous/notFound).

Assert renderEnvelope output parses back with JSON.parse and has no newline except the trailing one, and that statusLines output equals runStatus's current wording for a realistic payload (five lines).
Assert exitCodeOf maps all five statuses, that a null payload prints only the first line, and that missing name/indexer/root fall back to unknown/unrecorded.
details.verify:
cd app && $HOME/.bun/bin/bun test tests/cli-render.test.ts && $HOME/.bun/bin/bun run typecheck
Done when: both commands pass and the four status lines match the current wording character for character (compare against app/src/index.ts runStatus).

progress.detail: Created app/src/shared/cli/render.ts (EXIT_FAILURE=1, EXIT_USAGE=2, renderEnvelope, statusLines, exitCodeOf; only `import type { Envelope }` from #shared/envelope, payload narrowed structurally from unknown) and app/tests/cli-render.test.ts (12 tests). Verify from app/: `$HOME/.bun/bin/bun test tests/cli-render.test.ts` -> 12 pass, 0 fail, 26 expect() calls, exit 0; `$HOME/.bun/bin/bun run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit) -> exit 0. Wording checked character for character: regex-normalised format literals from src/index.ts runStatus (lines 796-803) are string-identical to render.ts statusLines (project two spaces, database one, graph four, health three; first line `${envelope.status}: ${envelope.summary}`); trailing newline present, five lines with a payload, one without. Scoped biome check on both files clean (pre-existing unrelated format error in concurrently created src/shared/cli/args.ts, not touched). Note: app/package.json gained a "bin.cgraph" entry at 16:21:28, before any file of mine was written - not mine, left untouched.

Orchestrator verification: `bun test tests/cli-render.test.ts` 12 pass / 0 fail; combined run of both phase_0 test files 36 pass / 0 fail; `bun run typecheck` exit 0; `bun run lint` exit 0 (the earlier args.ts format complaint the worker saw was fixed by TASK-001 before this check). Diff scope: only new app/src/shared/cli/render.ts and app/tests/cli-render.test.ts; render.ts imports only `type Envelope` from #shared/envelope, no tool/indexer/fs import. Accepted non-blocking deviation: a payload missing db_path or a numeric field renders `unknown` rather than `undefined`; runStatus never hit that path because its payload was typed.

tasks.title: Register the cgraph bin entry in package.json

details.goal: `bun link` inside app/ installs a `cgraph` command that runs app/bin/codegraph.ts, which already carries a `#!/usr/bin/env bun` shebang.
details.contract: Add `"bin": { "cgraph": "./bin/codegraph.ts" }` to app/package.json, as a top-level key next to `imports` and `scripts`. Keep `name`, `type`, `private`, `imports`, every script and every dependency exactly as they are; add no dependency and change no version. The existing scripts keep their meaning because `index`, `status`, `mcp` and `worker` all stay valid `cgraph` verbs, so `bun run index` still bootstraps. Do not run `bun link` or install anything globally — it is a documented user step, not part of this task.
steps: Read app/package.json and app/bin/codegraph.ts to confirm the shebang line exists.
Insert the `bin` block after `private` and before `imports`.
Confirm the file still parses and the scripts are unchanged.
details.verify:
cd app && $HOME/.bun/bin/bun -e 'const p=JSON.parse(await Bun.file("package.json").text()); console.log(p.bin.cgraph, Object.keys(p.scripts).length)'
Done when: it prints `./bin/codegraph.ts 12` (all twelve existing scripts kept), `git diff --stat` shows only app/package.json, and `head -1 bin/codegraph.ts` still prints the bun shebang.

progress.detail: Added top-level "bin": {"cgraph": "./bin/codegraph.ts"} to app/package.json between "private" and "imports" (only file modified; +3 lines, no other hunks). Verify from app/: `$HOME/.bun/bin/bun -e 'const p=JSON.parse(await Bun.file("package.json").text()); console.log(p.bin.cgraph, Object.keys(p.scripts).length)'` -> "./bin/codegraph.ts 12" (exit 0). `head -1 bin/codegraph.ts` -> "#!/usr/bin/env bun". Key order now name,type,private,bin,imports,scripts,dependencies,devDependencies; all 12 scripts (mcp,index,status,dev,test,typecheck,lint,build,db:generate,db:drift,db:parity,acceptance) and all 4+4 dependency versions unchanged. Repo root `git status --porcelain` -> " M app/package.json" plus pre-existing " M .ppm/cgraph-cli/tasks/phase_0.json" (unrelated to this task, already dirty at intake); no untracked files. No bun link, no installs, no lockfile touch.

Orchestrator verification: `cd app && bun -e '...p.bin.cgraph...'` printed "./bin/codegraph.ts 12", exit 0. `head -1 bin/codegraph.ts` still "#!/usr/bin/env bun". git diff for app/package.json is a single +3 hunk inserting the bin block after `private`; no other tracked file touched (only .ppm task file, which the plan manager owns).
